name: global-news-digest
description: Global news digest fetching from major news organizations across 6 regions using parallel fan-out mode

steps.name: init-date
steps.prompt: Get today's date in a human-readable format. Return only the date string.

steps.name: fetch-north-america
steps.prompt:
Fetch these North American news RSS feeds and extract top 5 recent articles (last 24h) from each:

🇺🇸 USA - Associated Press: https://feeds.ap.org/apnews/top25 
🇺🇸 USA - NPR: https://feeds.npr.org/1001/rss.xml
🇨🇦 Canada - CBC: https://www.cbc.ca/cmlink/rss-topstories
🇲🇽 Mexico - Mexico News Daily: https://mexiconewsdaily.com/feed/

Extract for each: headline, summary, source country, publication time. Return as structured list.

steps.name: collect-and-summarize
steps.prompt:
You are a global news editor creating a comprehensive international news digest.

Date: {{today_date}}

You have gathered news from these regions. Create a well-organized digest:

**NORTH AMERICA** (USA, Canada, Mexico):
{{na_news}}

**EUROPE** (UK, Germany, France, Norway, Netherlands):
{{eu_news}}

**ASIA-PACIFIC** (Japan, China, India, Australia, Singapore):
{{ap_news}}

**MIDDLE EAST & AFRICA** (Al Jazeera, Israel, South Africa, Nigeria, Egypt):
{{mea_news}}

**SOUTH AMERICA** (Brazil, Argentina, Colombia):
{{sa_news}}

**SCANDINAVIA** (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark):
{{scandi_news}}

TASK:
1. Review all articles and select the most significant 15-20 stories globally
2. Group them by category: World Affairs, Politics, Business/Economy, Tech/Science, Culture/Society
3. Write concise 1-2 sentence summaries for each
4. Note the source country for context
5. Keep total length under 2000 characters

FORMAT (Discord markdown):
```
🌍 **Global News Digest — {{today_date}}**

**🌐 World Affairs**
• [Story] — Summary (🇺🇸/🇬🇧/etc)
• [Story] — Summary (🇩🇪/🇫🇷/etc)

**💼 Business & Economy**
• [Story] — Summary (source country)

**🔬 Tech & Science**
• [Story] — Summary (source country)

**🎭 Culture & Society**
• [Story] — Summary (source country)

_Covering 6 regions, 15+ countries — OpenFang Global News_
```
